title: Mistral opens the weights of its trillion-parameter Large 4 model
dek: Mistral has released improved Large 4 weights, giving developers a trillion-parameter multimodal model to customize and host under its open-weight license.
whatHappened: Mistral released improved Mistral Large 4 weights on October 29, 2026, following an earlier public preview; Hugging Face documented the release that day.
Mistral describes Large 4 as a one-trillion-parameter, natively multimodal model with low, medium and high reasoning modes.
The model uses the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, with separate commercial licensing rules for Model-as-a-Service offerings.
whyItMatters: Downloadable weights let organizations customize and self-host the model rather than relying exclusively on a hosted API.
take: Our view: deployment control is the headline here; parameter count alone does not establish which model is best for a workload.
openQuestions: Mistral says a full technical report is still forthcoming.
